name: Lekstraatsynagoge
description: Abraham Elzas designed this restrained modernist synagogue complex, completed in1937, with a stone-faced main hall and a lower yellow-brick synagogue and residence wing. The small synagogue remains in use; the main hall later housed the Resistance Museum and an auction house.
funFact: The Hebrew inscription on the otherwise largely blank front quotes1Kings6:13. Elzas had worked with LeCorbusier; this modernist building stands among the Amsterdam School architecture of PlanZuid.
